text:
maria: Quick heads-up — I started a focused pass to consolidate glossary entries that are causing confusion (esp. "model family" vs "model variant" vs "model profile"). Found a mismatch in SDK examples that could confuse users during migrations. Looking for a quick triage + someone to own wording + a small snippet fix.
kevin: SG. Paste the offending snippet?
maria: Found in /docs/guides/migration and /docs/reference/sdk/python/examples. One uses `model_variant` and one uses `model` for the same param. Example:```python
client.generate(model_variant="redwood/guanaco-7b-q4", prompt=...)
``` vs ```python
client.generate(model="redwood/guanaco-7b-q4", prompt=...)
```
laura: Oof. That will trip up folks doing find/replace. Prefer standardizing on `model` as the param name and include variant in the value (e.g., `redwood/guanaco-7b-q4`). Keeps SDK ergonomics aligned with REST.
sam: +1 for `model`. Suggest short glossary excerpt: "model family" = base model (e.g., guanaco-7b); "variant" = quantization/packaging suffix (e.g., -q4); "profile" = serving config (latency/cost).
maria: Good. Can someone craft 2–3 sentences for the glossary and a changelog note for the SDK PR? Also add a one-line migration note under /docs/guides/migration for quick find/replace guidance.
kevin: I can take the SDK PR edit. Will update examples and run tests.
laura: I'll draft the glossary blurb + migration note. Quick draft:
"model family": the canonical name of a model (e.g., `guanaco-7b`) representing architecture + size.
"variant": implementation-specific suffixes or tags (e.g., `-q4`, `-int8`) that indicate quantization or packaging.
"profile": Redwood serving profile (e.g., `low-latency`, `cost-optimized`) that maps to runtime and resource choices.

kevin: Nice — Laura, drop the blurb in the glossary PR and ping me. I'll change `model_variant` -> `model` in SDK examples and add a short comment: `# use model param; include variant in value`
maria: Flagging docs-ci to run link/lint once changes land.
docs-ci: Link check started for branch: docs/glossary-merge-1789 — found 1 broken link in `/docs/guides/migration.md` (line 42): https://old.example.com/migrate -> 404.
sam: Replace that link with the new migration anchor `/docs/guides/migration#migrating-params`.
laura: Will update. Also a tone note: migration guide currently says "you must" a lot. Propose softer phrasing: "we recommend" or explicit steps like "to migrate, replace X with Y" unless it's a breaking change.
kevin: Agreed. Be prescriptive for actual breaking removals; otherwise, recommend wording.
maria: Action items:
1) laura: publish glossary blurb + migration text (ETA EOD)
2) kevin: update SDK snippets + tests (ETA tomorrow morning)
3) laura or sam: fix broken link in migration guide and soften tone
4) docs-ci: run link/lint after PRs merge

laura: I'll push the PR with glossary + migration edits and tag @kevin @maria.
kevin: Will open SDK PR after, reference laura's PR.
docs-ci: Link check queued — will run CI after merges.
maria: One more tiny ask: add a one-line example in the glossary of exact usage for common tasks, e.g.:```text
For prompts: model='redwood/guanaco-7b-q4'  # variant included in value
```
sam: That example is perfect. Recommend adding a cross-ref: "See: SDK param naming" linking to the examples section.
laura: Added that to my draft. Ping me in the PR thread for quick review. :thumbsup:
maria: Perfect. I'll close this thread after both PRs are merged. Thanks everyone!
